summary: Skip commit-observer evaluations for unchanged writer loans and index probes for read-only or rolled-back loans, with native committed-table dependency routing

replay.detail: No replay or projection semantics change.

compatibility.detail: Existing startup drains and real deadlines remain active. Confirmed SQLite write commits probe the claims index once, including otherwise empty commits: ignored AUTOINCREMENT inserts can advance its sequence without row hooks or total_changes. Explicit and implicit sequence advances wake claims-index dependents. Read-only and fully rolled-back loans do not probe the index. Writer observation work counters are exposed through the performance endpoint. Custom SQLite builds must enable SQLITE_ENABLE_PREUPDATE_HOOK; bundled builds enable it automatically.

recovery.detail: Lost native observation coverage conservatively invalidates dependent readers. SQLite builds missing required native hook support refuse writer initialization.
